assets.desc: a YOUNG Scots pine with orange-brown upper bark and a high umbrella crown of dusty green needle clumps: thin straight trunk, small sparse crown, about a quarter of the size of a mature tree. Strong readable VOLUME like Project Zomboid sprites: one key light from the top-left for everything, clearly lit top-left surfaces, shaded right and lower parts, dark ambient-occlusion where it meets the ground, rounded masses built from 3-4 value steps, subtle cool bounce light in the shadows; muted natural colors (not grey, not saturated)
